description: Generate registry.json, BATCH-REPORT.md, and ZIP the templates folder.
steps: Generate templates/registry.json listing all 50 templates with their slugs, categories, and metadata
Generate BATCH-REPORT.md at repo root with: template number, name, slug, files created, editable text slots, media slots, style controls, reference fidelity (all 'inferred'), remaining issues
ZIP the entire templates/ folder into templates.zip at repo root
Final STATUS.json update confirming all 50 complete
acceptance_criteria: templates/registry.json exists and lists all 50 templates
BATCH-REPORT.md exists at repo root with all required columns
verification: cat templates/registry.json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(len(d["templates"]))' should output 50
findings: All 3 artifacts generated successfully: templates/registry.json (50 entries), BATCH-REPORT.md (70 lines, full table with all slots/controls), templates.zip (218K). STATUS.json already confirmed 50/50 completed.
